pageObjects.name: ApprovalsPage

methods.description: Opens the queue. Employees get a 403 page.

methods.name: rejectExpense

users.description: Head of People. Can manage employees and decide on anyone's requests.
Engineering manager. Line manager of employee, qaEngineer and platformEngineer.
Sales manager. Line manager of salesExecutive and deactivated.
Dev Patel. Has a pending leave request (lr-001) and a pending expense (ex-001).
Amira Hassan. Has approved leave and a rejected unpaid request.
Jack Whitfield. No requests at all.
Sophie Clarke. Reports to the sales manager, not the engineering manager.
Leon Baptiste. Deactivated and cannot sign in.

seeded.description: Dev Patel's pending annual leave, 5 working days, waiting for the engineering manager.
Sophie Clarke's pending annual leave, waiting for the sales manager.
Dev Patel's pending travel expense of £42.50.
Every employee starts the year with this many days of annual leave.

helpers.name: isoDate
helpers.description: Date helpers for tests. All dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD) in UTC, matching the application. Tests use relative dates so they keep passing next month and next year.

helpers.name: mondayWeeksAhead
helpers.description: The Monday of the week that starts the given number of weeks from now. Always in the future.

tests.title: Manager approves a direct report's leave request
Rejecting a leave request requires a comment
Manager only sees requests from their own reports
Rejected expense shows the manager's comment to the employee
Employee can sign in and sees their dashboard
Wrong password is refused with a message
Signing out returns to the sign-in page
Employee cannot open the add-employee form
Employee can submit an expense claim
Claim over the £5,000 cap is rejected
Claim dated in the future is rejected
Employee can submit an annual leave request
Annual leave beyond the remaining balance is rejected
Employee can cancel a pending request and the days return to the balance
